items.title: Pakistan win warm-up match ahead of England Test series
items.description: Pakistan warmed up for their first Test against England at Headingley from Wednesday with a seven-wicket win over a County Select XI as Saud Shakeel hit an unbeaten hundred and Imam-ul-Haq scored 80.

items.title: SunRisers, Super Giants out to deny Rockets a Hundred double
items.description: There could be a Trent Rockets double and a Sam Billings four-peat at Lord's on Sunday as the 2026 edition of The Hundred draws to a close.

items.title: Godolphin's Gold Cup hero Trawlerman retired
items.description: Trawlerman, winner of the Gold Cup at Ascot last year, has been retired after picking up an injury at Goodwood.

items.title: Sunderland agree £25.6m fee for defender Methalie
items.description: Sunderland agree a £25.6m fee to sign left-back Dayann Methalie from Toulouse.

items.title: Coppull impresses in Hungerford success
items.description: Coppull stepped up in distance to land a second Group Two of his career under an enterprising ride from Hector Crouch, who completed a big-race double in the Visit Malta Hungerford Stakes at Newbury.

items.title: Inter sign England full-back Spence from Tottenham
items.description: England full-back Djed Spence signs a five-year deal at Inter Milan as he makes a move to Italy from Tottenham.

items.title: Burton 1-1 Stevenage
items.description: Olly Sanderson bundled home in stoppage time to snatch Stevenage a point in a 1-1 draw against Burton.

items.title: Plymouth 1-3 Stockport
items.description: Stockport eased to a sparkling 3-1 League One opening-day win at Plymouth.

items.title: Crawley 0-1 Crewe
items.description: Josh March headed the winner in the fifth minute of stoppage time as 10-man Crewe got the better of nine-man Crawley at the Broadfield Stadium.

items.title: Chesterfield 0-1 Fleetwood
items.description: Veteran striker Ched Evans scored the only goal of the game, finding the net against one of his former clubs to give Fleetwood Town an opening day 1-0 victory at Chesterfield.

items.title: Charlton hit back to beat Derby
items.description: Tyreece Campbell's impressive start to the new season continued as his 80th-minute goal earned Charlton a 2-1 victory over Derby at The Valley.

items.title: Chair double fires QPR to victory
items.description: Ilias Chair scored twice as QPR came from behind to beat Portsmouth 3-1 and claim their first win at Fratton Park in 26 years.
